name: Rizuhble's Arsonist Infernus
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Sell it for a second counter.
Get after Healbane if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Swift Striker for it.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.
Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Kelvin, Geist, Vyper.
Stuns keep stopping you before you can ult.
Sell Swift Striker for this, or Burst Fire if it's gone.
Sell Titanic Magazine for this, or Superior Duration if it's gone.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
Instead of Ricochet when their frontline stacks bullet resist.
changes: Alchemical Fire (3.2k) and Boundless Spirit (4.8k) out of core; Spirit Shredder (1.6k at 22.4k) into Spirit Rend (1.6k) in their place. Pros take Shredder 46% / Rend 33% against Boundless 20% and never Alchemical Fire; the lockbuilds official build has both Shredder and Rend. Core drops from 49.6k to 44.8k, still 12 slots.
Boundless Spirit moved to the rich box as the upgrade of Improved Spirit; Spirit Burn added there after it (sells Titanic Magazine).

Rest kept from the round-5 rebuild of the in-game build: 4.8k spirit at 5.6k, 4.8k health at 10.4k (Bullet Lifesteal + Spirit Lifesteal + Battle Vest, no Fortitude), 4.8k gun at 14.4k. Pro core still Extra Spirit, Improved Spirit, Mystic Vulnerability, Rapid Rounds, Swift Striker, Toxic Bullets, Spirit Lifesteal, Superior Duration, Escalating Exposure, Spiritual Overflow, Ricochet.
Healbane (96% pro) not added: Toxic Bullets already cuts their healing by the same 35%.
Ability order: Near-unanimous: unlock Afterburn (100%), then 2, 1, ult, Afterburn T1 (100%), Flame Dash T1, then max Afterburn by point 8, Napalm/Flame Dash next, ult last. Ours is that path exactly.

Item fit: Battle Vest → Healbane (both 1.6k vitality, same slot, health still 4.8k at 10.4k). Afterburn is spirit damage every 0.5s, so Healbane's -35% healing is up the whole fight from ~9 min instead of waiting for Toxic Bullets at 14.4k, and +7 spirit feeds the burn. Public: tracklock pro 96%, tracklock core, deadlocked.gg early core, lockbuilds 15.6k buys; Battle Vest only shows as a 328-buy counter on lockbuilds (50.3% WR) and in no core list.

Item fit: Berserker → Burst Fire (both 3.2k gun T3, same slot at 20.8k). Berserker needs 120 sustained damage taken per stack, which a mid-range gun Infernus doesn't want to soak. Afterburn ignites at 8.1% per bullet hit (about 13 hits) and the gun fires 9.5 shots/s with 27 rounds, so Burst Fire's +10% and +32% fire rate on hit puts the burn on sooner. Public: tracklock late situational, lockbuilds 6.6k buys 50.7% WR; Berserker isn't in tracklock, deadlocked.gg or lockbuilds' top 30.

Item fit, kept: Extra Spirit 99% / Improved 96%, Rapid Rounds 77% → Swift Striker 82%, Duration Extender 40% → Superior Duration 70% (on Afterburn), Mystic Vulnerability 93% → Escalating Exposure 69% (burn ticks every 0.5s, stack cooldown 0.7s), Bullet Lifesteal + Spirit Lifesteal 71% → Leech (lockbuilds 55% WR, deadlocked.gg core; heals off both gun and burn), Toxic Bullets 88%, Titanic Magazine 45%, Spirit Shredder 46% → Spirit Rend 33%, Spiritual Overflow 60%, Ricochet (tracklock core, 14.2k lockbuilds).

Round 9: Worth a try: Suppressor (1.6k). Afterburn ticks spirit damage every 0.5s, so Suppressor's -28% fire rate (4.5s) never drops on a burning target; also +6 spirit, +8% bullet resist. Same price and slot as Titanic Magazine. Core kept: matches tracklock.gg pro builds, last 30 days, checked 2026-10-19 (Extra/Improved Spirit 97%, Swift Striker 93%, Mystic Vulnerability 81%, Toxic 73%, Superior Duration 71%).

Round 12: 'Worth a try' box removed (Suppressor; not Kieran's pick, no current pro Infernus buys it). Checked all 10 types: Duration Extender on Afterburn works (its burn duration uses the spirit-duration scale in the game files, BurnDuration 3s to 3.7s); Mystic Vulnerability, Toxic Bullets, Titanic Magazine, Spirit Shredder, Superior Duration, Escalating Exposure and Spiritual Overflow are all in pro Infernus top lists (tracklock, last 30 days, 139 games); Burst Fire and Ricochet feed the burn build-up; no duplicates, no colour-changing swaps, no pivots.

Round 13: notes cut to what a player wouldn't know (UPDATE 3), desc is a short style label (UPDATE 4), Counters notes name the right heroes (Spirit Resilience: real spirit-damage heroes, no Haze; Counterspell: a parryable ability).

Round 14: Extended Magazine added at the end of Early so Titanic Magazine is an upgrade instead of a fresh T2 at 16k (Extended Magazine 81.6% early on seemeta Oct 5-19, 70% early on tracklock pro, Gunfernus Perfected lane); spirit 4.8k still at 5.6k, health 4.8k moves to 11.2k, gun 4.8k passes at 15.2k (5.6k) and lands 6.4k at Titanic. Spirit Rend bought straight at 24k instead of a fresh Spirit Shredder at 22.4k (no fresh T2 late; same 3.2k total). Spirit Burn now sells Healbane (so Healbane's 'second counter' note moves to Titanic Magazine, and the third-counter note is gone) (its pricier version) instead of Titanic Magazine; Divine Barrier added as Dispel Magic's rich upgrade. Notes: Spirit Shredder explanation emptied; Unstoppable and Armor Piercer notes rewritten without jargon; Counterspell example is Lash's ult; Dispel Magic examples are item debuffs it purges; Spirit Resilience lists Vyper instead of Infernus.

Round 15: Armor Piercer moved out of Counters into its own 'Swap for Ricochet' box (it replaces Ricochet late, which contradicted the Counters desc 'get after Healbane, sell Swift Striker'). Swift Striker note emptied (repeated the Counters desc).
Round 17: Renamed "Rizuhble's Burn Gun Infernus" (style in the name); rich Boundless Spirit note "Upgrade of Improved Spirit."; lane sell and Divine Barrier notes use the standard wording.
Round 19: checked against current public builds of this style; it is a real style, no changes.
Round 20: late list to 75.2k: Indomitable (second health step), Crippling Headshot and Witchmail added (Gunfernus 579362 late boxes).

Round 23 (kit): Duration Extender on Afterburn rechecked: Afterburn's max burn duration uses the tech-duration scale (abilities.vdata BurnDuration scale_function_tech_duration), so it works. Napalm T2 +15% lifesteal and T3 +33% damage taken fit the lifesteal/Healbane items. Ballistic Enchantment on Napalm considered and rejected (walked: Titanic Magazine is the Extended Magazine upgrade, swapping it strands Extended Magazine; afterburn damage is spirit, so +weapon power helps only the 5.5-damage bullets). No changes.
